classification.difficultyReason: Use equality marks and opposite-side totals to form and solve perimeter equations for notched figures.

content.prompt: Find the unknown value $x$, given the perimeter.

spec.description: L-shape with equal short top and right edges, and equal bottom and inner vertical edges.
spec.mathematics: Bottom and inner vertical are 5 cm; top and right outer vertical are x cm. Both equality classes are retained.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied givens and equality marks are visible.

answer.worked:
The top side is $x$ cm and the inner vertical side is $5$ cm. The left side is $(5+x)$ cm and the inner horizontal side is $(5-x)$ cm.
$$\begin{align*}P&=x+5+(5-x)+x+5+(5+x)\\P&=20+2x\\24&=20+2x\\2x&=4\\x&=2\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Rectangle with a rectangular notch entering upwards from its bottom edge.
spec.mathematics: Five single-marked segments are each x cm. The outer height is 5 cm and the overall width is 3x cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied givens and all five equality marks are visible.

answer.worked:
Each marked side is $x$ cm. The top side is $3x$ cm and both outer vertical sides are $5$ cm.
$$\begin{align*}P&=3x+5+x+x+x+x+x+5\\P&=8x+10\\34&=8x+10\\8x&=24\\x&=3\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Rectangle with a narrow notch entering downwards from the top.
spec.mathematics: The bottom and both notch verticals have double equality marks and are x m. The outer height is 12 m.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied givens and all three double equality marks are visible.

answer.worked:
The upper horizontal segments, including the notch base, total $x$ m. Each notch vertical is $x$ m and each outer vertical is $12$ m.
$$\begin{align*}P&=x+x+x+x+12+12\\P&=4x+24\\60&=4x+24\\4x&=36\\x&=9\text{ m}\end{align*}$$
